name: Pre-Commit Validation
description: Run before writing any file. All items must pass.

items.check: Are all mandatory rule files loaded and confirmed in the Prerequisites section?
items.pass: All required rules are loaded and confirmed
items.fail: One or more required rules are not confirmed loaded
items.fix: Load the missing rule file. Re-read the Prerequisites section and confirm all files.

items.check: Is the correct task prompt selected based on the user request and index.json keyword matching?
items.pass: The correct prompt is selected for the task
items.fail: The wrong prompt or no prompt is loaded
items.fix: Re-run index.json keyword matching against the user request. Load the correct prompt.

items.check: Are all lazy-load rule files identified in the Lazy-Load Rules section and their trigger conditions understood?
items.pass: Lazy rules and their triggers are identified
items.fail: One or more lazy rules are not identified or trigger conditions are unclear
items.fix: Re-read the Lazy-Load Rules section. Load the lazy rule file when its trigger condition is met.

items.check: Does the code being written belong in the correct layer (Manager, Model, Action, State, Notification)?
items.pass: Code is placed in the correct architectural layer
items.fail: Code is in the wrong layer (e.g., SQL in an action, domain logic in Game.php)
items.fix: Move the code to the owning component. Follow ARCH-001 through ARCH-022 for component boundaries.

items.check: Is the code free of SQL queries in action handlers and Game.php?
items.pass: No SQL in actions or Game.php
items.fail: SQL found in an action method or Game.php
items.fix: Move all SQL to the owning Manager's methods. Actions and Game.php must contain zero database access.

items.check: Is Game.php free of domain logic and under 300 lines?
items.pass: Game.php is orchestration-only and under 300 lines
items.fail: Game.php contains domain logic or exceeds 300 lines
items.fix: Extract domain logic into the owning Manager. Game.php retains only delegation and coordination.

items.check: If the prompt references canonical examples, are they loaded before writing code?
items.fail: One or more examples are not loaded
items.fix: Load the example files before writing code. Follow the load instructions in the workflow steps.
